bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; appropriating money for the Phoenix Correspondence Commission.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; PHOENIX CORRESPONDENCE COMMISSION. +]

[+$10,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of administration for payment to the Phoenix Correspondence Commission to support the work of the commission to further the role of federalism with our federal constitutional structure. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; appropriating money for the Phoenix Correspondence Commission.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; PHOENIX CORRESPONDENCE COMMISSION.

$10,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of administration for payment to the Phoenix Correspondence Commission to support the work of the commission to further the role of federalism with our federal constitutional structure.
additions: $10,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of administration for payment to the Phoenix Correspondence Commission to support the work of the commission to further the role of federalism with our federal constitutional structure.
